protocol.reason: All 12 original pairs used separate processes and matched exactly. Initial time-to-quality seed19 pair shared one process and differed slightly after Adam, then more after L-BFGS. Investigate process-lifecycle confounding without changing thresholds. No backend cause is established.
comparisons: snapshot weight state values on CPU
protocol.limitations: Exploratory diagnostic, not a replacement for original five-seed gates. Exact equality may still depend on backend determinism. Two-arm repeat alone does not identify a specific CUDA cause or estimate within-arm variability.

reports.limitations: Only L-BFGS snapshots after completed Adam. Two adjacent successes required. Snapshot I/O overhead included in wall times and reported separately; no interpolation. Analytical evaluation follows all optimizer steps within each trial, never changes training or stopping. Physical autograd used independently of derivative executor. Final warm inference is measured separately.
